## Pitchside 1.1.1

**Download:** `Pitchside.apk` below (Android 7.0+, ~45 MB). Install guide: https://calebtek.github.io/Pitchside/#install

### New since 1.0
- 🛡️ **Top clubs**: 100+ preset clubs and national teams with search, league filters and quick packs (Big 8, Top 16 Europe, Champions League 36, World Cup 32)
- 🎲 **Tally draw**: players pick a colour tally, then spin to get random clubs (up to 4 each)
- 🔤 3-letter club codes on badges (MCI, MUN…)
- 🔒 Fewer permissions: only Internet (unused) and Vibrate (haptics)

### Notes
- Installs over 1.0 / 1.1 and keeps your tournaments.
- This APK is for direct download. When the Google Play version launches you'll need to uninstall this one first.

Privacy policy: https://calebtek.github.io/Pitchside/privacy.html
